subject: Legal handoff cadence & assignees for MAP milestone — MSA/DPA/SLA redlines
messages:

Subject: Quick recap + MAP milestone: legal redlines (ownership & cadence)

Priya — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. A short recap and proposed next steps so we have the MAP milestone tidy for legal handoff: 

TL;DR: I attached a one-sheet MAP (MAP_Finexa_v1.xlsx) with milestones. The immediate milestone is: Legal redlines for MSA/DPA/SLA. Proposed owners and turnaround times below. Please confirm if this matches Finexa’s expectations.

Call notes (high level):
- Goal: Production pilot (10k qpm peak) by Jan 31, 2027; production target Feb 28, 2027.
- Key dependencies: SOC2 attestation evidence, routing policy on PHI fields, network peering options.
- Procurement: Finexa procurement needs an executed MSA + DPA; SLA thresholds to be clarified.

Proposed MAP milestone: Legal redlines (MSA / DPA / SLA)
- Deliverable: Redwood draft MSA + DPA attached (MSA_Redwood_redline_v0.1.docx).
- Owner (Redwood): Redwood Legal (initial draft + suggested language).
- Owner (Finexa): Finexa Legal (customer redline/response).
- Target: Initial exchange complete within 10 business days from today (12/21/2026).
- Turnaround cadence: 1st loop — Finexa redlines within 5 business days after Redwood draft; 2nd loop — Redwood responds within 3 business days; subsequent loops — 3 business days each.
- Escalation path: If DPA or SLA language requires product changes or custom tooling (e.g., custom retention hooks), Redwood PM (marcus_lin@redwood.com) and engineering will confirm scope within 3 business days after Redwood legal flags the request.

Next steps we need from Finexa:
1) Confirm that Finexa Legal will review and target the 5-business-day window for first redline.
2) Share any non-negotiable clauses up-front (security/retention/indemnification).
3) If you prefer to own the first redline instead of Redwood sending an initial draft, say so and we’ll flip owners and adjust timelines.

Attachments: MAP_Finexa_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones); MSA_Redwood_redline_v0.1.docx (Redwood draft).

Thanks — I’ll keep this thread as the legal milestone bucket in the MAP.

— Ben

Thanks Priya — appreciate the confirmation. Per request I’ve attached the MAP (MAP_Finexa_v1.xlsx) and a slightly expanded legal milestone section pasted below for clarity. If Finexa is good with these owners/timelines I’ll update the MAP and mark the milestone ready for handoff.

LEGAL REDLINE MILESTONE (explicit checklist):
- Step 0: Redwood shares draft MSA + DPA (done, attached). Owner: Redwood. Date: 12/07/2026.
- Step 1: Finexa Legal completes first pass and returns redlines. Owner: Finexa. Target: by 12/14/2026 (5 business days).
- Step 2: Redwood Legal reviews customer redlines and returns consolidated response (with product/ops scope notes if applicable). Owner: Redwood. Target: within 3 business days after Step 1 (by 12/17/2026).
- Step 3: Joint review call if material operational changes are requested. Owner: both. Target: schedule within 3 business days after Step 2.
- Step 4: Finalize DPA and SLA fine print (if new controls required, PM/Eng estimates on scope). Owner: Redwood legal + PM. Target: within 7 business days of Step 3 (or earlier if simple).

Turnaround expectations (guiding principle):
- 1st pass (customer) = 5 business days
- Redwood responses = 3 business days per loop
- If product work needed, PM (marcus_lin@redwood.com) to provide scope/ETA within 3 business days of ask

If Finexa prefers tighter SLAs for legal loops, we can shorten but that will require prioritized legal review (I’ll coordinate).

I’ll mark the MAP milestone as "ready for legal" once you confirm the 12/14 target.

Attachments referenced: MAP_Finexa_v1.xlsx, MSA_Redwood_redline_v0.1.docx (Redwood initial redline).

— Ben
